description: The China Land Surveying and Planning Institute derives a one-kilometre land-use-degree index for China in 2020. It aggregates national land-change survey information using four levels of human intervention, separating unused land, forest/grass/water, agriculture and urban settlement. ScienceDB provides the named resource with CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse. Its description explains the grid scale but does not establish a file format or whether the delivery uses raster cells or a vector grid. The index can supply an explanatory layer for land-development and infrastructure-location simulations. It is a composite measure of land use, not a direct count of buildings, people or infrastructure capacity. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A dataset of 1km Grid Comprehensive index of land use degree Density in China(2020）
